name: Kyonyuu Sugite Kirawareteru kamo!? to Nayanderu Yuujin no Muchi Kanojo o Haramase Onaho ni Shita Ken
original_name: 巨乳すぎて嫌われてるかも！？と悩んでる友人の無知彼女を孕ませオナホにした件
source:
Your pal gives you a pretty hardcore inferiority complex, he always seems to be one step ahead of you in life, work, relationships, EVERYTHING! What is really starting to drive you crazy, as a “normal” red blooded male is that your bro scored the hottest chick you’ve ever seen but the guy is still sweating about holding hands with her?!

While on the way to work, kicking it in the back of the bus having some hot and heavy ‘bro talk’ as you admonish him for not making moves on his caked up, busty, goth baddie girlfriend who appears but the bewitching beauty herself Rina!

She hardly seems to react at all which is pretty wild considering you were just talking about how you’d kill to bury your face in her mega milkers thinking you dodged a bullet you go on with your day like normal until later that night you get a text from a strange number, its Rina! Looks like she’s a little concerned that her relationship with your friend isn’t progressing and she’s worried it’s because of her boobs?!

Well, if your bro isn’t gonna make a move this is your moment to quickstep in front of your buddy by graduating from your virginity first but by fucking his girlfriend to do it, talk about a violation of the bro code… YEAH RIGHT!

你这哥们儿让你自卑得厉害。过日子、干工作、谈恋爱，什么事他都好像比你快一步！可最让你这个“正常”的血性男儿抓狂的是，他都追到了你这辈子见过最辣的妞儿，居然还在为要不要牵手紧张？！

上班路上，你俩窝在公交车后排，正聊得火热。你数落他，女朋友又是翘臀又是巨乳，还是个哥特风的大美人，他怎么就是不动手？结果说着说着，面前出现的不是别人，正是那个勾人魂魄的大美人凛那！

她几乎一点反应也没有。你刚刚可还说，多想把脸埋进她那对豪乳里，死都甘愿。这样居然也能蒙混过关，真够离谱。你以为自己躲过一劫，照常过完了一天。哪知当天夜里，一个陌生号码发来了短信，竟然是凛那！原来她有点发愁，和你哥们儿的关系迟迟没有进展，会不会是自己的胸太大了？！

好吧，既然你哥们儿不打算出手，这下可轮到你抢他一步，赶在他前头破处了，而且上的是他女朋友！这可真对不起兄弟情义…哈，谁管那个！
